name: TogglyActivateRelease
description: Activate a Toggly release and optionally wait for gates to pass
helpMarkDown: Activates a release, applying all feature flag changes. Can wait for gates to pass before activation. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.name: releaseId
inputs.label: Release ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The release ID to activate. Defaults to the variable set by previous tasks.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target environment to activate (for example Production or Staging). Sent as the environment query parameter.

inputs.name: waitForGates
inputs.label: Wait for Gates
inputs.helpMarkDown: Poll gate status and wait for all gates to pass before activating

inputs.name: gateTimeout
inputs.label: Gate Timeout (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum time to wait for gates (default: 300 seconds)

inputs.name: gatePollInterval
inputs.label: Gate Poll Interval (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Time between gate status checks (default: 10 seconds)
